questions.q: What temperature rise threshold is deemed disastrous?
questions.why: Paris agreement aims to stay below 2 °C, the disaster threshold.

questions.q: Which city could be fully submerged if sea levels rise 1.2‑2.4 m?
questions.why: The text says Bangladesh's 164 million‑person area would be completely submerged.

questions.q: What ancient source could release revived diseases?
questions.why: Ancient bacteria are trapped in Arctic ice sheets, posing revival risk.

questions.q: What genre of films does Wallace‑Wells compare to climate fears?
questions.why: He mentions movies like Mad Max and The Bird Box as post‑apocalyptic examples.

questions.q: What does the book suggest about the Paris climate goals?
questions.why: The overview calls the Paris goals hopelessly optimistic and too little, too late.
